literal: Even in ruin there is one benefit: a rod that extends and measures friends.
translation: Even in ruin, there is a certain benefit: it is a measuring rod to stretch out and gauge the true worth of one's friends.
modern: துன்பத்திலும் ஒரு நன்மை உண்டு; அது உறவினர்களையும் நண்பர்களையும் நீட்டி அளந்து பார்க்கும் ஒரு அளவுகோல் ஆகும்.
explanation: This couplet explains that adversity or ruin is not entirely without value, as it brings a unique benefit. It acts as a measuring rod to test and gauge the true loyalty of those who claim to be our friends. When we are prosperous, many gather around us, but when ruin strikes, only true friends remain. Thus, misfortune serves as a tool to stretch out and accurately measure who our real companions are.
